title: Upscale Music Row Corner Unit- Pool, Rooftop, Gym
description:
Brand new high-end condo on famous Music Row w/ free garage parking. Corner unit with a private patio and incredible building amenities including a Pool, massive rooftop deck w/ a view of the city & outdoor seating, gym, conference room, two lounges w/ a kitchen, pool table +more! You cannot beat this location - walk past recording studios on your way to coffee, shopping, restaurants & live music. Washer/Dryer in the condo. Only 2 miles to Downtown Broadway bars & 0.5 mi to Belmont & Vanderbilt!

The space
HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ Located on legendary Music Row, steps from historic recording studios and live music venues 
★ 2 miles to Broadway bars 
★ 1 King Bed, 1 Queen Bed + Queen Pull-out Couch
★ 2 Bedrooms + 2 Full Bathrooms
★ Pool (outdoors, open seasonally)
★ Corner unit with a Private Patio overlooking 16th Ave S.
★ HD Smart TVs with all the apps in the living room + primary bedroom
★ Massive rooftop deck with outdoor seating and stunning views of the city
★ Rooftop lounge with a pool table, kitchen, and business center 
★ Front-desk assistance during daytime hours
★ Gym with treadmills, ellipticals, rower, stationary bike, and free weights 
★ Secure building with key code entry required and overnight security personnel 
★ Walk to incredible restaurants, bars, coffee shops and shopping 
★ Additional lounge area on first floor of building
★ Entire condo furnished with thoughtful, high-end decor for maximum comfort 
★ Soon-to-be-completed pool available for Spring and Summer 2025 bookings
★ Parking (unassigned) in a secure garage connected to the condo building 
★ High-speed WiFi 
★ Easy elevator access 
★ Washer and Dryer in the condo 
★ Central AC + Heat 
★ Keypad entry (no keys to worry about) 
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs 
★ Keurig coffee machine + K-Cups provided 
★ Quiet location yet convenient access to nightlife 
★ Near Vanderbilt, St. Thomas and Centennial Hospitals 

This spacious, high-end condo is an oasis in the heart of the city, full of thoughtful style + comfort. Massive windows let in lots of natural light, plus blackout shades to allow a restful night's sleep. Our private corner unit patio is spacious and overlooks legendary Music Row, it is the perfect place for you to plan your adventures in Nashville over your morning coffee. All aspects of our home have been thoughtfully designed with your ease + convenience in mind. High-quality mattresses + bedding, all supplies & details provided, tasteful elements incorporated throughout, and plenty of space. This upscale condo, with a ton of incredible amenities, will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville.

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: King bed + Smart TV
Bedroom 2: Queen Beds
Living Room: Queen Pullout Couch + Smart TV

BATHROOMS:
Full size with a standing shower, connected to Bedroom 1
Full size with a shower/tub combo, located next to to Bedroom 2 and the Kitchen

Guest access
You'll have the entire condo to yourself! The rooftop deck, lounges, conference room and gym are shared building amenities that you will have full access to.

Other things to note
Parking in the garage is unassigned and on a first-come, first-serve basis. Additional free street parking also available. The pool is open seasonally. It is up to our HOA as to when the pool opens and closes each year.

Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
